parts.label: (i)
parts.text: A random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{B}(2540, 0.001)$. Use the Poisson approximation to the binomial distribution to find $\text{P}(X > 1)$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Explain why the Poisson approximation is appropriate in this case.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Two independent random variables, $S$ and $T$, have distributions $\text{Po}(2.1)$ and $\text{Po}(3.5)$ respectively. Find the mean and standard deviation of $S + T$.
